description: Monotone piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation (PCHIP) of curve control points, as scipy.interpolate.PchipInterpolator evaluates it: interior derivatives by the weighted harmonic mean (zero at local extrema), end derivatives by the three-point formula limited to keep shape. Periodic (hue) curves drop the x = 1 point and extend the points by two on each side before interpolating.
license: Generated numeric reference data; no third-party content. Same terms as the repository.
source: Fritsch, F. N. and Carlson, R. E. (1980), Monotone Piecewise Cubic Interpolation, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 17(2); Fritsch and Butland (1984) weighted harmonic mean derivatives, as implemented by scipy.interpolate.PchipInterpolator

float64Port.use: A float64 port of the same PCHIP derivatives and Hermite evaluation must match every sample within 1e-12.
